name: Plover River
gaugeName: PLOVER RIVER NEAR STEVENS POINT, WI
blurb: Plover River paddling near Stevens Point. The documented lower trip starts below Jordan Dam and finishes at Iverson Park beach; the longer Wayside–Lehner listing still needs dam and carry review.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Markers identify agency-listed access; the map states whether a landing or an approximate facility area has been reviewed. Mileage is preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry; it is not a surveyed paddling route. Difficulty has not been independently rated for every section. Check current conditions, hazards and access with the managing agency before paddling.
sections.accessReview: Dam crossing/portage unresolved: Van Order, Jordan, McDill. A legal, usable route around the barrier has not been established. Do not plan this as a continuous float.
sections.routeReview: This section includes Van Order, Jordan, McDill and needs a closer check of the landing or portage. Consult the agency guide and signed access; do not assume you can paddle through a dam.

sections.difficulty: Intermediate paddling; moving water and wood (local guide)
sections.notes: Start below Jordan Dam and finish at Iverson Park beach, before McDill Pond and its dam. The published local guide gives 7.75 miles and about 3 hours of paddling, with frequent tree obstructions and a need for maneuvering experience. Check levels and current wood with local operators before travel; allow extra time for obstructions and stops.
sections.routeReview: Access markers only. The older river centerline differs from the channel visible in county imagery, so its dotted path is withheld. Exact riverbank connections are not mapped.

guideTimes.conditions: The local guide gives a 3-hour canoe/kayak reference for Jordan Park below the dam to Iverson Park beach. No flow level, paddling pace or stop allowance is specified; this is not a live estimate or a raft/tube travel-time prediction. Wood, water level and stops can change the duration.
guideTimes.sourceName: Stevens Point Area Pedal, Paddle & Hike Guide (2022), printed pages56–57

notices.title: Launch below Jordan Dam
notices.text: This trip uses the separate below-dam canoe access south of Highway 66. Jordan Pond launches are above the dam and are not the put-in for this section. Inspect the intended launch and take-out during your shuttle.

notices.title: Wood and changing water levels
notices.text: The local guide rates this trip for intermediate paddlers because of frequent downed trees and maneuvering in moving water. Confirm present conditions with local operators and allow time for obstructions; the published duration is a reference, not a guarantee.
notices.sourceName: Stevens Point Area — Lower Plover paddling guide
